requiredFacts.criticality: A live credential never leaves: every pattern match and every assignment of an obviously secret-named key is replaced by the redaction mark on write and again on render, and output the part-two envelope would still refuse as secret-shaped is replaced whole rather than passed on.
requiredFacts.preservesInput: the message is still captured with the credential replaced by its mark, and the credential itself is held by name in sealed custody (Rule 100); nothing is discarded

holds.portion: rule 4's first irreversible-miss case is enumerated: the one text wall that decides alone, on an exact pattern test, and preserves its input
holds.remainder: the part-two envelope's own secret-shaped refusal (src/facts/envelope.ts) and every caller's application of this wall are not themselves declared sites, and no module reads this declaration at runtime
